spans.text:
If cache service fails completely, ai-gateway should:

1. Log the error with details
2. Return error to client (fail fast, no silent fallback)
spans.note: The document demonstrates good tool/action safety practices. It includes explicit error handling, validation rules (returning 400 for invalid configurations), fail-fast behavior rather than silent fallback on errors, and structured authentication requirements for both inbound and outbound calls.

spans.text: Users should be aware of this when configuring compound models with caching enabled. Consider:
spans.note: The document preserves user agency by providing transparent cost implications, giving users multiple options for cache management (automatic markers, explicit cache names, manual warming), and being upfront about cost trade-offs with multi-region caching.
